g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Every round-table evidence session in the APPG on AI's published programme, all held in the UK Parliament. Its themes page names "AI Skills and Workforce Preparedness" as a key area. The 25 January 2027 session on robotics and manufacturing does ask what skills gaps need addressing; none of the fourteen is given over to the question.'

text.tspan: Every round-table evidence session in the APPG on AI's published programme, all held in the UK Parliament.
Its themes page names "AI Skills and Workforce Preparedness" as a key area. The 25 January 2027 session on robotics
and manufacturing does ask what skills gaps need addressing; none of the fourteen is given over to the question.

svg.text: Source: APPG on Artificial Intelligence 2026-2027 programme brochure, Big Innovation Centre, read 13 August 2026.
Quarterly Advisory Board meetings are excluded — internal governance, not evidence sessions. The brochure dates the environment
session 10 October on its detail page and 18 October in its overview table; the later date is shown. Grounded AI Practice.
